authorization.text: Dann lasse forge die Mocks ebenfalls erarbeiten. Danach vergleichen wir die 4 proben

purpose: Create an independent moving Agentarium mock for four-sample comparison.

shared_brief.format: One embeddable HTML fragment: one root div, scoped style, scoped script; no doctype/html/head/body.
semantics: visible divergence before a decision point
each agent has an abstract non-human glyph and label
weak ambient motion plus event-driven pulses
event labels only; no invented agent quotes
constraints: all JS isolated in an IIFE
shared_brief.output: Return exactly one fenced html code block and no prose.

variant_brief: Living weave: free violet/cyan curved fibers in diagonal depth. Local activity densifies fibers and sends visible impulses between glyphs. Divergent strands remain separate until a bright decision knot joins them. Avoid rigid lanes, people, robots, portraits and dashboard cards.
